16px;">Value Propositions</font></span></p><p style="font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; padding-top: 0.66001rem; font-feature-settings: &quot;kern&quot;, &quot;onum&quot;, &quot;liga&quot;; border-box; font-weight: 700;">Accessible Healthy Food:</span>&nbsp;Offering bundles that prioritize easy access to a variety of healthy, local foods, catering to those seeking healthier lifestyles and higher food quality.</li><li style="box-sizing: border-box; font-feature-settings: &quot;kern&quot;, &quot;onum&quot;, &quot;liga&quot;; margin-left: 1rem;" data-line-end="5" data-line-start="4" class="has-line-data"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: 700;">Cost-Effective Choices:</span>&nbsp;By reducing middlemen, your platform can offer more competitive prices, making healthy and local food more accessible to a broader audience.</li><li style="box-sizing: border-box; font-feature-settings: &quot;kern&quot;, &quot;onum&quot;, &quot;liga&quot;; margin-left: 1rem;" data-line-end="7" data-line-start="5" class="has-line-data"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: 700;">Convenient Shopping Experience:</span>&nbsp;A mobile app provides a modern, user-friendly shopping experience, allowing buyers to easily browse, order, and arrange delivery of local produce, surpassing the convenience of traditional market shopping.</li></ul><p style="font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; padding-top: 0.66001rem; font-feature-settings: &quot;kern&quot;, &quot;onum&quot;, &quot;liga&quot;; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 1.33999rem; color: rgb(55, 61, 73); white-space-collapse: collapse;" data-line-end="8" data-line-start="7" class="has-line-data"><em style="box-sizing: border-box;">For Sellers:</em></p><ul style="font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 0.83999rem; padding-top: 0.16001rem; color: rgb(55, 61, 73); white-space-collapse: collapse;"><li style="box-sizing: border-box; font-feature-settings: Income Potential:</span>&nbsp;The direct-to-consumer model eliminates middlemen, allowing sellers to retain a greater portion of their sales revenue.</li><li style="box-sizing: border-box; font-feature-settings: &quot;kern&quot;, &quot;onum&quot;, &quot;liga&quot;; margin-left: 1rem;" data-line-end="10" data-line-start="9" class="has-line-data"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: 700;">Lower Operational Costs:</span>&nbsp;Shortening the supply chain reduces transportation and storage costs, increasing sellers’ margins.</li><li style="box-sizing: border-box; font-feature-settings: &quot;kern&quot;, &quot;onum&quot;, &quot;liga&quot;; margin-left: 1rem;" data-line-end="11" data-line-start="10" class="has-line-data"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: 700;">Market Expansion Opportunities:</span>&nbsp;The platform provides sellers with the tools and visibility to reach a wider customer base, expanding their market beyond local boundaries.</li></ul></h4></li></ol></div><div style="font-size: 10px"><br></div>" p.span: Access to a large number of potential seller clients due to the small average farm size, which is among the lowest in Europe.
The presence of services like Glovo/Wolt makes Gdańsk an ideal launch location, leveraging the competitive courier ecosystem for logistics.
The app’s features aligning with farmers’ demands can position ‘Fresh Near Me’ as a supportive platform during a time of widespread agricultural unrest.
Poland’s robust access to IT talent can ensure high-quality technical development and innovation for the platform.

span.font: A mobile app designed to connect consumers directly with local producers, simplifying the process for everyone to access and enjoy fresh, locally-grown food. This platform is dedicated to supporting local communities and promoting healthier, sustainable food choices. With just a few clicks, users can go from landing on the app to checking out, making the entire process streamlined and user-friendly.

ul.li: Accessible Healthy Food: Offering bundles that prioritize easy access to a variety of healthy, local foods, catering to those seeking healthier lifestyles and higher food quality.
Cost-Effective Choices: By reducing middlemen, your platform can offer more competitive prices, making healthy and local food more accessible to a broader audience.

Convenient Shopping Experience: A mobile app provides a modern, user-friendly shopping experience, allowing buyers to easily browse, order, and arrange delivery of local produce, surpassing the convenience of traditional market shopping.

p.style: font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; padding-top: 0.66001rem; font-feature-settings: "kern", "onum", "liga"; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 1.33999rem; color: rgb(55, 61, 73); white-space-collapse: collapse;

ul.style: font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 0.83999rem; padding-top: 0.16001rem; color: rgb(55, 61, 73); white-space-collapse: collapse;
ul.li: Increased Income Potential: The direct-to-consumer model eliminates middlemen, allowing sellers to retain a greater portion of their sales revenue.
Lower Operational Costs: Shortening the supply chain reduces transportation and storage costs, increasing sellers’ margins.
Market Expansion Opportunities: The platform provides sellers with the tools and visibility to reach a wider customer base, expanding their market beyond local boundaries.

font.span: Blogs, videos, and articles that provide value around healthy living, local food benefits, and sustainability to attract and educate your audience.

span.style: background-color: initial; font-style: italic; box-sizing: border-box;

font.span: Participation in or sponsorship of local health and sustainability events can increase awareness and engagement.

em.span:
For Sellers (Rural Producers):
Direct Outreach: Engaging with rural producers directly through agricultural cooperatives, farmers’ markets, or local agricultural departments.
Agricultural Fairs and Events: Presence at or partnerships with events where producers gather can serve as a valuable channel for onboarding.
Online Platforms: Utilizing agricultural forums, rural community groups, and online marketplaces to introduce your platform.
Training Workshops (Webinars): Offering workshops or webinars on digital literacy, platform benefits, and online marketing could attract less tech-savvy producers.
